The company's products also include Woven fabrics and Sutli (fibrillated twisted thread). It operates a manufacturing plant in Poly Park, Howrah, West Bengal, India.

NIPPOBATRY.NS.d: Indo National Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes dry cell batteries and lighting products in India. It offers AA, AAA, C&D, alkaline, and 9V batteries; torches; and emergency power backup products, as well as mosquito bats. The company also provides square LED downlights, rechargeable bulb, pulsar linear, head lamp, LED tubelights, LED bulbs, LED flood lights, and grid based LED street lights.

NUVAMA.NS.d: Nuvama Wealth Management Limited operates in India across capital markets, asset management and wealth management. Its services include debt advisory, clearing, portfolio and investment advisory, institutional and retail securities brokerage, financial product distribution and lending against securities.

PDPL.NS.d: Parenteral Drugs (India) Limited operates as a healthcare company in India. The company manufactures pharmaceutical products, including intravenous infusion, inhalation, veterinary infusion, etc. It also offers IV fluids, such as carbohydrates and electrolytes, diuretics, dialysis and irrigation solutions, anti-infective and anti-fungal products, and others; and oncology and anesthesia products.

PITTIENG.NS.d: Pitti Engineering Limited manufactures and sells electrical steel laminations, stampings, motor cores, sub-assemblies, die-cast rotors, and press tools in India and internationally. The company manufactures laminations for use in home appliances, aerospace, railways, power generation, medical equipment, consumer motors, industrial motors, special purpose motors, etc., as well as rotor aluminum die-casting and rotor shaft insertion products.

PREMCO.NS.d: Premco Global Limited manufactures and exports a range of industrial fasteners. Their products include bolts, nuts, screws, and washers used in various engineering applications. The company is located in India.

PVSL.NS.d: Popular Vehicles and Services Limited is an automotive dealership operator in India. It sells, services and repairs commercial vehicles and passenger cars, as well as electric vehicles with two or three wheels, trades used passenger vehicles, distributes spare parts and accessories, and brokers third-party financing.

RUCHIRA.NS.d: Ruchira Papers Limited manufactures and sells paper and paper products in India and internationally. The company offers writing and printing papers, which are used for manufacturing notebooks; and colored papers used in the fabrication of spiral notebooks, wedding cards, shade cards, children's coloring books, colored copier papers, and bill books. It also provides Kraft papers for making corrugated boxes/cartons, as well as for other packaging products, such as textile tubes and paper core-pipes.

SANSTAR.NS.d: Sanstar Limited, set up in 1982, with its head office in Ahmedabad, makes and supplies plant-derived specialty ingredients to domestic and international markets. It was known as Continental Papers Limited until April 2012, and its products include glucose and starch-based items such as liquid glucose.

SGIL.NS.d: Synergy Green Industries Ltd. makes and exports castings, pig iron and pneumatic tools, among them turbine, industrial, metal and steel castings and windmill parts. Its supplies for non-automotive industrial uses include machined components, castings in steel and graded grey and spheroidal graphite iron. It was founded on 8 October 2010 and has its head office in Kolhapur.

SINTERCOM.NS.d: Sintercom India Limited manufactures and sells sintered metal components and auto components for various automobile applications primarily in India. The company offers engine components, including drive gears, chain sprockets, belt pulleys, and engine shaft bearing caps; transmissions components, such as synchroniser hubs, dog rings, and drive-train gears for 2-wheeler and 4-wheeler automobile platforms; and components of exhaust systems, sensor bosses, and sensor parts for various vehicle platforms.

TATAINVEST.NS.d: Tata Investment Corporation Limited is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm operates as an investment company in India. Its activities primarily include investing in long-term investments in equity shares, equity-related securities and other securities of companies in a range of industries. The company also distributes mutual funds and other investment related securities. Tata Investment Corporation was founded in 1937.

TIGERLOGS.NS.d: Tiger Logistics (India) Ltd. provides logistics solutions for moving goods within India and internationally. Its services include ocean and air freight, project and defence logistics, domestic transport, supply chain financing, cold chain management and customs clearance, and it uses a proprietary digital freight booking platform called FreightJar.

TRANSCOR.NS.d: Transcorp International Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker TRANSCOR and traded in INR. Its country is India.

VADILALIND.NS.d: Vadilal Industries Limited manufactures and sells ice-creams in India and internationally. The company also offers frozen desserts and other dairy products; and processes and exports processed food products, such as frozen fruits, vegetables, pulp, ready-to-eat and ready-to-serve products, etc. In addition, the company provides flavored milk products under the Power Sip brand name, as well as paneer and ghee products. Further, it engages in the forex management and money changing, as well as chemical businesses.

WAAREEENER.NS.d: Waaree Energies Limited, set up in 1989, with its head office in Mumbai, manufactures and exports solar photovoltaic (PV) modules for residential, commercial, industrial and institutional uses. It has three divisions, including solar module manufacturing and EPC (engineering, procurement and construction).
